description: Removes the currently applied discount on a subscription, such as a discount code or promotion. The response may include a deletion confirmation flag.

inputSchema.description: Request model for deleting a subscription discount.

subscription_id.description: The ID of the subscription from which to remove the discount. Must start with 'sub_' followed by alphanumeric characters.
subscription_id.title: Subscription Id

inputSchema.title: DeleteSubscriptionDiscountRequest

name: delete_subscription_discount

Coupon.description: Coupon details within the discount object.

amount_off.description: Amount in cents to subtract from the invoice total.
amount_off.title: Amount Off

created.description: Time the coupon was created (Unix timestamp).
created.title: Created

duration.description: Describes how long the discount applies. One of: 'forever', 'once', or 'repeating'.
duration.title: Duration

duration_in_months.description: If duration is 'repeating', specifies the number of months.
duration_in_months.title: Duration In Months

livemode.description: Whether this coupon is in live mode.
livemode.title: Livemode

max_redemptions.description: Maximum number of times the coupon can be redeemed.
max_redemptions.title: Max Redemptions

metadata.description: Set of key-value pairs for custom metadata.
metadata.title: Metadata

redeem_by.description: Date after which the coupon can no longer be redeemed (Unix timestamp).
redeem_by.title: Redeem By

times_redeemed.description: Number of times this coupon has been applied.
times_redeemed.title: Times Redeemed

valid.description: Whether the coupon is currently valid.
valid.title: Valid

Coupon.title: Coupon

DeleteSubscriptionDiscountResponse.description: Response model for a deleted subscription discount.

coupon.description: Details of the coupon that was part of this discount.
coupon.title: Coupon

customer.description: ID of the customer this discount was applied to.
customer.title: Customer

deleted.description: Always true for a successful deletion.
deleted.title: Deleted

id.description: Unique identifier for the deleted discount object.
id.title: Id

object.description: String representing the object's type. Always 'discount' for this endpoint.
object.title: Object

start.description: Unix timestamp when the discount was applied.
start.title: Start

subscription.description: ID of the subscription this discount was removed from.
subscription.title: Subscription
